name: Ikuyo Jinja ni Otouto to!
source:
''Come on, don't spend the entire New Year's playing video games!!
Let's go visit a shrine!''

A New Year's Day scene of Hina and Chikage after the events of [url=https://vndb.org/v24820]Denai Heya kara Otouto ga![/url].

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8287]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“好啦，别整个新年都窝着打游戏！
一起去神社参拜吧！”

描绘[url=https://vndb.org/v24820]《Denai Heya kara Otouto ga!》[/url]故事之后，阳菜与千景元旦时光的片段。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8287]Freem![/url]]
